title: Psalms 10
paragraphs: ¹ Why, LORD, do you stand far off? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble? ² In his arrogance the wicked man hunts down the weak — may they be caught in the schemes they devise. ³ He boasts about the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD. ⁴ In his pride the wicked person does not seek God; in all his thoughts there is no room for God. ⁵ His ways always prosper; your laws are beyond his notice; he sneers at all his enemies.

⁶ He tells himself, "Nothing will ever shake me" — he swears, "No one will ever bring me trouble." ⁷ His mouth is full of lies and threats; trouble and evil are under his tongue. ⁸ He lurks in ambush near the villages; from his hiding place he murders the innocent, watching in secret for his victims. ⁹ He waits in hiding like a lion in cover; he lies in wait to catch the helpless, dragging them off in his net. ¹⁰ He crouches, he lies low, and the helpless fall victim to his strength.

¹¹ He says to himself, "God has forgotten; he covers his face and never sees." ¹² Arise, LORD! Lift up your hand, O God. Do not forget the helpless. ¹³ Why does the wicked man despise God? Why does he say to himself, "He won't call me to account"? ¹⁴ But you do see trouble and grief; you consider it and take it in hand. The victim commits himself to you; you are the helper of the fatherless. ¹⁵ Break the arm of the wicked man; call the evildoer to account for his wickedness until you find none.

¹⁶ The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations will perish from his land. ¹⁷ LORD, you hear the desire of the afflicted; you encourage them, and you listen to their cry, ¹⁸ defending the fatherless and the oppressed, so that mere mortals will never again terrorize them.
